name: com.omh.android.auth.nongms.presentation.redirect.RedirectActivity
description: When an app uses Open Mobile Hub's sign-in flow on a device without Google Play services, this Activity opens a browser sign-in page and receives the identity provider's return. It then completes the sign-in and returns the result to the app.
disableEffect: Accounts using this Open Mobile Hub sign-in flow cannot complete login, so the app may not accept that sign-in method.
